pages.title: Working Soil
pages.text: Support crop growth with working soil and irrigation.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: A Sprinkler waters neighboring farmland. Compost and fertilized soil have native usage rules; a large onion or lettuce is a possible continuation, not a required random outcome.

pages.title: Spread fertilized soil
pages.text: Fertilized Soil has a limited nutrient supply. A Pitchfork applies it around nearby crops; a hoe turns fresh soil into Fertilized Farmland that resists trampling.

pages.title: Grow a larger crop
pages.text: Compost differs from single-use Bone Meal: it supports neighboring plants and special large onion and lettuce forms.

pages.title: Water farmland without a pond
pages.text: The Sprinkler waters nearby farmland. Its spray also interacts with fires, campfires and candles; the installed version determines its reach.

pages.title: Inspect animal feeding levels
pages.text: Wear Dungarees as leggings. They help show animal feeding levels and prevent farmland trampling; they are working equipment, not merely decoration.
